UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user settings, monthly budget goal, and alert preferences for SubStop.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Optional email address of the user.

monthlyBudget.description: Target monthly subscription budget in the user's currency.

renewalAlertsEnabled.description: Whether 3-day upcoming renewal alerts are enabled.

trialWarningsEnabled.description: Whether trial expiration warnings are enabled.

weeklyDigestEnabled.description: Whether weekly spend digest alerts are enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: A user's recurring subscription or free trial tracked in SubStop.

userId.description: Owner user UID matching parent /users/{userId} path.

name.description: Service or vendor name (e.g., Netflix, Spotify, iCloud+).

monthlyCost.description: Normalized monthly cost of the subscription.

nextBillingDate.description: Formatted next billing date string (e.g., Dec 2, 2026).

nextBillingEpochDay.description: Next billing or trial end date represented as UTC epoch day.

brandColorHex.description: Brand accent hex color for the service squircle icon.

iconKey.description: Icon identifier key for rendering the service emblem.

paymentLabel.description: Optional payment card or method label.

notes.description: Optional user notes or cancellation instructions.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether renewal reminder is enabled for this subscription.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when subscription was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when subscription was last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: User profile, budget goal, and alert preferences scoped by UID.

/users/{userId}/subscriptions/{subscript.description: User's recurring subscriptions subcollection isolated under their UID.
